1: // Canvas Dodger – minimal implementation
2: // Assumes an HTML <canvas id="game"></canvas> present.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Ensure full‑size canvas
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship definition
12:   const ship = {
13:     w: 40,
14:     h: 20,
15:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
16:     y: canvas.height - 30,
17:     speed: 5,
18:     dx: 0,
19:     draw() {
20:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
21:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
22:     },
23:     update() {
24:       this.x += this.dx;
25:       // clamp within canvas
26:       if (this.x < 0) this.x = 0;
27:       if (this.x + this.w > canvas.width) this.x = canvas.width - this.w;
28:     }
29:   };
30: 
31:   // Meteor definition
32:   class Meteor {
33:     constructor() {
34:       this.r = Math.random() * 15 + 10; // radius 10‑25
35:       this.x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - this.r * 2) + this.r;
36:       this.y = -this.r;
37:       this.speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3; // 2‑5
38:     }
39:     update() {
40:       this.y += this.speed;
41:     }
42:     draw() {
43:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
44:       ctx.beginPath();
45:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
46:       ctx.fill();
47:     }
48:     offScreen() {
49:       return this.y - this.r > canvas.height;
50:     }
51:   }
52: 
53:   const meteors = [];
54:   let lastSpawn = 0;
55:   const spawnInterval = 800; // ms
56:   let startTime = null;
57:   let score = 0;
58:   let gameOver = false;
59: 
60:   function spawnMeteor(ts) {
61:     const m = new Meteor();
62:     meteors.push(m);
63:   }
64: 
65:   function checkCollision(m) {
66:     // simple AABB‑circle test
67:     const closestX = Math.max(ship.x, Math.min(m.x, ship.x + ship.w));
68:     const closestY = Math.max(ship.y, Math.min(m.y, ship.y + ship.h));
69:     const dx = m.x - closestX;
70:     const dy = m.y - closestY;
71:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < m.r * m.r;
72:   }
73: 
74:   function update(ts) {
75:     if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
76:     const delta = ts - (lastSpawn || ts);
77:     // spawn meteors
78:     if (ts - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
79:       spawnMeteor(ts);
80:       lastSpawn = ts;
81:     }
82:     // increase speed gradually
83:     meteors.forEach(m => m.speed += 0.00001);
84:     // update objects
85:     ship.update();
86:     meteors.forEach(m => m.update());
87:     // remove off‑screen meteors
88:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
89:       if (meteors[i].offScreen()) meteors.splice(i, 1);
90:     }
91:     // collision
92:     if (meteors.some(m => checkCollision(m))) {
93:       gameOver = true;
94:     }
95:     // score as seconds survived
96:     score = Math.floor((ts - startTime) / 1000);
97:   }
98: 
99:   function render() {
100:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
101:     ship.draw();
102:     meteors.forEach(m => m.draw());
103:     // UI
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
105:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
106:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
107:     if (gameOver) {
108:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
109:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
110:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
111:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
112:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
113:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   function loop(ts) {
118:     if (!gameOver) {
119:       update(ts);
120:     }
121:     render();
122:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
123:   }
124: 
125:   // Input handling
126:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
127:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.dx = -ship.speed;
128:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.dx = ship.speed;
129:   });
130:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
131:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.dx = 0;
132:   });
133: 
134:   // Start loop
135:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
136: })();
